mass_exclusions: SB/GD-SB: no mass parameter exists on this component, so its structural steel is NOT counted. It carries geometry and a stiffness RATIO only.
An ILS cannot express a mass belonging to no component, so a bare inertia on the header is not representable.
modelling_boundaries: IW-A PRESENT (GD-TP) alongside an EA structure. The published studies excluded bulkheads deliberately, so the connection-layout effect could be seen alone -- results here are NOT comparable with those benchmarks.
Connectors attach ON THE PIPE CENTRELINE: active_connectors() returns an axial station and a moment arm, carrying no offset from the pipe axis. Listed under Limitations in both studies.
SB/GD-SB: P_vt = -0.2300 m (signed position, y positive DOWN). The published EA-SB set used P_vt = 0 THROUGHOUT, against a non-zero default here -- so a defaulted GD-SB does not reproduce that set.
Strain reported downstream from this layout is for RELATIVE comparison between arrangements, not absolute code compliance.

branch_gd_st_gate.rule: Every GD-B branch terminates at GD-ST through the compatible feature defined by the selected anchor; L terminals are horizontal and Z terminals are vertical.

items.rule: When GD-SB is provided to protect GD-VLV, its dimensions must be fitted to the valve envelope and clearance basis rather than left at generic EDAS defaults.

branch_valve_top_frame_gate.rule: Branch-valve layouts must use a compatible ILT-L/ILT-Z standard anchor, keep the branch tee/entry, valve and end inside GD-ST, and avoid F2/F2D unless evidence justifies the header-strain penalty.

design_basis.base_depth: GD-SB bottom set just below GD-VLV lower envelope with limited clearance to avoid unnecessary elevation strain.
design_basis.base_length: GD-SB flat length spans inline valve plus connector landing stations with reduced extra length.
design_basis.connector_spacing: P-S support connectors placed on GD-TP landings outside the valve weld/transition envelope.
evidence: EDIKB elevation-strain correlation: larger support vertical offset increases strain; therefore minimize GD-SB P_vt and clearance.
design_basis.peak_strain_basis: Probable pipeline peak strain is expected near connector/load-transfer region; exact value/location remains uncertain without detailed analysis.

items.rule: For GD-VLV protection by GD-SB, size the base from the valve envelope plus limited clearance and keep the connector/elevation arm small unless EDIKB evidence justifies a larger offset.

valve_base_geometry.rule: GD-SB depth must clear the protected GD-VLV envelope without introducing unnecessary elevation arm that is known to increase strain.

shroud_stiff_evidence_gate.rule: A GD-VLV inside/with GD-SH must apply analogous C1 GD-SH plus stiff-component EDIKB evidence to valve placement and shroud dimensions before the layout can be treated as evidence-applied.
